verification.method: Automated evidence gate (content.bundle_problems). The frequency research was independently re-checked against the papers by a second research agent (46 sources: 22 confirmed, 23 corrected, 1 partly checkable; log at the end of docs/research/training-frequency-evidence.md). The exercise citations were independently re-checked by a second agent against docs/research/exercise-evidence.json and the papers.
